svg.title: The three conic sections
svg.desc: Three graphs. Left: the parabola y = 0.5 x squared with its vertex at the origin. Middle: the ellipse x squared over 9 plus y squared over 4 = 1, centered at the origin, with vertices (3, 0) and (-3, 0) and the ends of the short axis at (0, 2) and (0, -2). Right: the hyperbola x squared minus y squared over 2.25 = 1, with vertices (1, 0) and (-1, 0), two branches opening left and right, and dashed asymptotes y = 1.5x and y = -1.5x.
